permit.applies: The person for whom the permit is sought, or someone on their behalf, files with the Labour Department's Employment Service, with the intended employer's statement (the Second Schedule form) unless self-employed; the Minister decides on the Chief of the Employment Service's report.
permit.first: The intended employer's statement; the Employment Service investigates the effect of the grant on employment opportunities open to citizens.

fees.what: Application or renewal fee (Labour Code s. F5(2), as amended by Act No. 13 of 2020)
Work permit fee, artist or entertainer, non-CARICOM national, a year (Work Permit (Fees) Order 2017; pro-rated for a shorter permit)

permit.feesNote: The Work Permit (Fees) Order 2017 (S.I. 2017 No. 5) charges an artist or entertainer XCD 1,000 a year if a CARICOM national, 2,000 otherwise, pro-rated for permits under a year; a single act or group of up to three for a week or less pays 600 or 1,200 (the row for over a week up to three months is printed blank). From 10 March 2025 CARICOM and Dominican Republic nationals pay no permit fee, only the application fee (S.I. 2025 No. 4).

sources.title: Laws of Antigua and Barbuda, Cap. 27, Labour Code, Division F (Work Permits)
sources.said: Application for a work permit, or its renewal or extension, shall be made by or on behalf of the person for whom the work permit is sought by the filing, with the Employment Service of the Labour Department, of an application in the form prescribed in the First Schedule … he shall take into consideration, among other things, the effect of the grant upon employment … There shall be paid by any person granted a work permit such fee as shall be prescribed by the Minister by Order.

sources.title: Antigua and Barbuda Labour Code (Amendment) Act 2020, No. 13 of 2020 (Official Gazette Vol. XL No. 44, 17 June 2020), FAOLEX copy
sources.said: in subsection (2) be repealing the words “ten dollars” and substituting therefor the words “one hundred dollars”.

sources.title: The Work Permit (Fees) Order, 2017 (S.I. 2017 No. 5, Official Gazette Vol. XXXVII No. 5, 19 January 2017)
sources.said: Categories of Workers | CARICOM Nationals | Non-CARICOM Nationals ... Artist $1,000.00 $2,000.00 ... Entertainer $1,000.00 $2,000.00 (a) Single or group entertainers not exceeding three in number (i) over one week but not exceeding three months [no fee printed] (i) Not exceeding one week $600.00 $1,200.00 (b) Each group of entertainers over three but not exceeding twelve (i) over one week but not exceeding three months $2,500.00 $5,000.00 (ii) not exceeding one week $1,000.00 $3,000.00 (c) each additional entertainer over twelve in a group (i) over one week but not exceeding three months $200.00(each) $500.00 (ii) not exceeding one week $100.00 (each) $200.00 (each) ... Person engaged in a profession not specified in this schedule $2,500.00 $4,500.00 ... Fees are to be pro-rated for work permits granted for periods less than one year
